user.title: Elkeuru Management Fee - Gas
user.description: Enter your GSE city gas (yesgse.com) login. The apartment management bill is set up separately via the 'Bill link' text entity after install.

kocom_user.title: Elkeuru Management Fee - Kocom Energy
kocom_user.description: Enter your Kocom ID to auto-discover the complex's wall-pad server address.

kocom_account.title: Elkeuru Management Fee - Kocom Energy login
kocom_account.description: The server address was filled in automatically. Enter your password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server.
error.ip_not_found: Could not find the complex server address for this Kocom ID.

gas_login.title: Gas login
gas_login.description: Re-enter this if your gas account password changed - it will be re-verified on save.

kocom_login.title: Kocom Energy login
kocom_login.description: Re-enter this if your Kocom password changed - the server address will be looked up again and re-verified on save.

citywaste_login.title: Food waste (citywaste) login
citywaste_login.description: Login for citywaste.or.kr. The first time this is saved it pulls the last 12 months at once; after that it only refreshes the last 2 months, on the 1st of each month.

error.invalid_time: Time must be in HH:MM format.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server.
error.ip_not_found: Could not find the complex server address for this Kocom ID.

bill_fetch_failed.title: Management bill fetch failed
bill_fetch_failed.description:
Fetching the bill link failed: {error}

If a new bill is out, try pasting that month's link into the 'Bill link' text entity again. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

gas_login_failed.title: GSE city gas login/fetch failed
gas_login_failed.description:
Fetching the gas history failed: {error}

If your password changed, re-enter it under Settings → Options → Gas login. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

kocom_auth_failed.title: Kocom Energy authentication failed
kocom_auth_failed.description:
Authenticating with the Kocom wall-pad server failed: {error}

If your password changed, re-enter it under Settings → Options → Kocom Energy login. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

citywaste_login_failed.title: Food waste (citywaste) login/fetch failed
citywaste_login_failed.description:
Fetching citywaste data failed: {error}

If your password changed, re-enter it under Settings → Options → Food waste login. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.
